title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. In this first face, draw a closed loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at the origin and ends at zero point zero four six nine, zero. The second line starts at zero point zero four six nine, zero and ends at zero point zero four six nine, zero point zero three one two. The third line starts at zero point zero four six nine, zero point zero three one two and ends at zero, zero point zero three one two. The fourth line starts at zero, zero point zero three one two and ends at the origin. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero four six nine to the sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and translate it using the translation vector zero, zero, and zero. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units, without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will create a new solid body. The final part is named the cylinder and has a rectangular top that is slightly wider than its cylindrical base. The length is zero point zero four six eight seven five units, the width is zero point zero three one two five units, and the height is zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
# Import necessary CAD-Query modules
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0469, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0469, 0.0312)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0312)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch
extruded_model = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformations
# Euler angles: -90.0, 0.0, -90.0
# Translation vector: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
transformed_model = (
    extruded_model
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (-1, 0, 0), -90)  # Rotate -90 degrees around X-axis
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, -1), -90)  # Rotate -90 degrees around Z-axis
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0))  # No translation needed
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = transformed_model

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
